production.direction_en: Odelia warns the party about mines. A bell pulse crosses the bridge; one lock of Fadyme’s ash-pale hair turns stark white, whiter than bone.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch5_bridge | the bell pulse: sting_bell_toll, then silence while the lock turns white; bgm_fadyme_theme returns only on 'Only tired.' | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Only tired. The wind is colder here.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You have been tired since the forest.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Consistent is not the same as well.

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: She does not answer. For the first time, he does not let the question go, and for the first time, she has nothing ready.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: A white strand. One more thing the mirror will remember before he does.
